summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/ into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style blob (string-array rotation via WV8StW, a large mixed-hex constants table n7gIxM, decoder hc1jfK9) with no readable code and no documentation in the package. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io conventions (aliased imports _0x488df8 = fs, _0x52943e = https; call-wrapper objects like YCZJE) to hide execFileSync, https.get, and reads of /etc/os-release. The package's declared purpose is a shared Jest configuration for React Native and does not require the Bun runtime or any install-time native execution. The fetched runtime is used solely to execute an opaque bundled payload on every install, bypassing scanners that only inspect Node-reachable code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
